# Front‑End Design & Technical Blueprint for a **Notes‑App Web Site** > **Goal:** Deliver a concise, actionable research package that tells a development team exactly **what to use, how to structure, and what to watch out for** when building a modern, responsive notes‑taking web application (frontend + Python‑backed API). --- ## 1. Best Python Libraries / Frameworks to Use | Layer | Recommended Library | Why It Fits a Notes App | Key Features | Typical Alternatives | |-------|---------------------|------------------------|--------------|----------------------| | **Web Framework / API** | **FastAPI** | • Async‑first, high‑performance (≈ 2‑3× faster than Flask/Django).
• Automatic OpenAPI/Swagger docs – great for front‑end integration.
• Pydantic models give strong data validation (important for note payloads). | - Async support (uvicorn).
- Dependency injection.
- Built‑in CORS middleware. | Flask (lighter), Django Rest Framework (full‑stack). | | **ORM / DB Access** | **SQLModel** (built on top of SQLAlchemy + Pydantic) | • Seamlessly shares models between API (Pydantic) and DB (SQLAlchemy).
• Very easy to generate migrations with Alembic. | - Declarative models.
- Type‑hints → IDE autocomplete. | SQLAlchemy core, Tortoise‑ORM (async‑only), Django ORM. | | **Authentication** | **FastAPI‑Users** (or **Authlib** for OAuth) | • Plug‑and‑play user registration, login, password reset, JWT & OAuth2.
• Works out‑of‑the‑box with SQLModel. | - JWT, cookie, OAuth2.
- Email verification. | custom JWT, Flask‑Login, Django auth. | | **Background Tasks / Scheduling** | **Celery** (with Redis) or **FastAPI‑Background** for simple jobs | • Off‑load heavy tasks (e.g., PDF export, email digests). | - Retries, monitoring. | RQ, Dramatiq. | | **Search / Full‑Text** | **Whoosh** (pure‑Python) or **Elasticsearch** (if scaling) | • Enables fast note search (by title, tags, content). | - Stemming, fuzzy matching. | PostgreSQL full‑text, MeiliSearch. | | **Testing** | **pytest** + **httpx** (for async API) | • Rich fixtures, async support. | - Parametrized tests, coverage. | unittest, nose. | | **Deployment** | **Uvicorn + Gunicorn** (workers) + **Docker** | • Production‑ready ASGI server. | - Auto‑reload in dev, graceful shutdown. | Hypercorn, Daphne. | > **Bottom line:** A **FastAPI + SQLModel** stack gives you a lightweight, type‑safe, async API that pairs nicely with modern JavaScript front‑ends while still being easy to extend (e.g., add GraphQL later). --- ## 2. Recommended Architecture ``` +-------------------+ +-------------------+ +-------------------+ | Front‑End SPA | HTTPS | API Gateway | Async | Workers (Celery)| | (React / Vue / | <------> | (FastAPI) | <------> | (PDF export, etc)| | SvelteKit) | | - Auth (JWT) | +-------------------+ +-------------------+ | - Rate limiting| | - CORS | +-------------------+ | v +-------------------+ | Persistence | | PostgreSQL | | (SQLModel) | +-------------------+ | v +-------------------+ | Search Index | | (Whoosh/ES) | +-------------------+ ``` ### Component Breakdown | Component | Responsibility | Tech Choices | |----------|----------------|--------------| | **Client** | UI/UX, offline support, PWA features, state management | React (with **Vite**), **TailwindCSS**, **React‑Query** (data fetching), **Zustand** or **Redux Toolkit** for global state | | **API Layer** | CRUD for notes, user management, auth, rate limiting | FastAPI + SQLModel + FastAPI‑Users + **slowapi** (rate limiting) | | **Database** | Persistent storage of notes, users, tags, revisions | PostgreSQL (JSONB for rich‑text metadata) | | **Search Engine** | Full‑text search, tag filtering | Whoosh (dev) → Elasticsearch/MeiliSearch (prod) | | **Background Workers** | Export to PDF/Markdown, email reminders, heavy indexing | Celery + Redis | | **Static Assets / CDN** | Serve compiled JS/CSS, icons, fonts | Vite build → **Cloudflare Workers** or **AWS S3 + CloudFront** | | **CI/CD** | Lint, test, build, containerize, deploy | GitHub Actions → Docker → Kubernetes (or simple Docker‑Compose for MVP) | | **Observability** | Logs, metrics, error tracking | **Sentry**, **Prometheus + Grafana**, **ELK** (optional) | --- ## 3. Important Considerations & Gotchas | Area | What to Watch For | Mitigation / Best Practice | |------|-------------------|-----------------------------| | **CORS & CSRF** | Mis‑configured CORS can block API calls; CSRF on cookie‑based auth. | Use FastAPI’s `CORSMiddleware` with explicit origins. Prefer **Authorization: Bearer** JWT (stateless) → no CSRF. | | **Authentication Flow** | Refresh‑token handling, token revocation. | Store short‑lived access token (15 min) + long‑lived refresh token (7 days) in **httpOnly** cookies. Use FastAPI‑Users built‑in refresh endpoint. | | **Rich‑Text Storage** | Storing HTML can lead to XSS. | Store **Markdown** or **TipTap JSON**; sanitize on render (`DOMPurify` on client, `bleach` on server). | | **Search Index Consistency** | Index may become stale after note updates/deletes. | Wrap DB commit & Whoosh index update in a single transaction; fallback to re‑index on startup. | | **Performance** | Large notes (≥10 MB) can blow memory in async handlers. | Enforce size limit (e.g., 2 MB). Stream uploads for attachments. | | **Offline Sync Conflicts** | Two devices editing same note offline → merge conflicts. | Implement **optimistic concurrency** using a `version` field; on conflict, present UI diff and let user choose. | | **Rate Limiting** | Abuse of API (e.g., brute‑force login). | Use `slowapi` (based on `limits`) → 5 req/s per IP for auth routes, 100 req/min for note CRUD. | | **Database Migrations** | Schema drift when adding fields (e.g., `pinned` flag). | Use **Alembic** with autogenerated migrations (`alembic revision --autogenerate`). | | **Testing Async Code** | Forgetting to `await` leads to hidden bugs. | Use `pytest-asyncio` fixtures; always test with `AsyncClient`. | | **Deployment Secrets** | Hard‑coding secrets (DB URL, JWT secret). | Store in environment variables; use Docker secrets or **HashiCorp Vault** for production. | | **Accessibility (a11y)** | Color contrast, keyboard navigation, screen‑reader support. | Run **axe** CI step; use semantic HTML + ARIA labels in React components. | | **SEO / Social Sharing** | SPA pages are not indexed well. | Provide **SSR** fallback via **Vite SSR** or **Next.js** if SEO is required; otherwise add a static landing page. | | **Data Export** | PDF generation can be CPU‑heavy. | Offload to Celery workers; limit concurrent workers; use `WeasyPrint` or `pdfkit` with headless Chrome. | | **Internationalization** | Future need for multi‑language UI. | Use **react-i18next** on front‑end; store note language metadata; keep strings externalized. | | **Legal / GDPR** | User data must be deletable on request. | Implement `/users/me` DELETE that cascades to notes; keep audit logs. | | **Versioning API** | Breaking changes later on. | Prefix routes (`/api/v1/notes`) and keep old version for at least 6 months. | | **Docker Layer Caching** | Large images slow CI. | Multi‑stage builds: first stage for dependencies (`requirements.txt`), second for compiled assets. | | **Browser Compatibility** | TipTap/Slate may need polyfills on older browsers. | Test on Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge;
